name: Stationary Cycling

instructions.description: Adjust the seat and place both feet securely on the pedals.
Maintain a smooth cadence and relaxed upper body.
Reduce resistance and pedal easily before stopping.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Recumbent Cycling meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Stationary Cycling.
Stationary Cycling — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Adjust the seat so pedaling is comfortable.
